name: Galaxy S4
notes: GT-I9505 only. Other Galaxy S4 variants (GT-I9500 Exynos, SGH-I337, SGH-M919, SCH-I545) need their own files. Experimental postmarketOS server v4 is catalogued; TWRP is also available separately.

modes.download: Power off (pull the battery if it hangs). Hold Volume Down + Home + Power until the warning screen, then press Volume Up for Download Mode.
modes.recovery: Power off. Hold Volume Up + Home + Power; let go of Power when it vibrates, keep the other two held until TWRP appears.

unlock.text: The GT-I9505 bootloader is not locked and has no OEM unlocking switch: Download Mode takes a custom recovery as it is.
steps: Back up everything you want to keep.
Remove your Google account (Settings › Accounts) so the phone does not ask for it after a later wipe.
Charge to at least 50 % and use a data USB cable.
hints: Do not follow newer Galaxy guides: there is no OEM unlocking toggle and no 7-day wait on this phone.
Flashing a custom recovery on a 4.3 or newer bootloader trips the KNOX warranty flag for good. The phone keeps working.

recovery.text: Download Mode still works after a bad flash. Stock firmware for your exact model and CSC is on SamFW.
